rootCauses.summary: The logo, lightning mark and wordmark still start at opacity zero, so a main-thread-heavy preload can leave the only painted state blank even after the CSS syntax is valid.
rootCauses.prediction: Brand identity remains visible at base style and throughout the animation timeline even if animation frames are delayed.
rootCauses.falsifier: Computed logo/wordmark opacity can still be zero during the boot gate.

rootCauses.summary: Waiting for the intro animation before starting application load would restore visuals by reintroducing the serial startup delay removed in iteration 2.
rootCauses.prediction: A visible base state fixes the blank gate without moving app load behind the intro timer.
rootCauses.falsifier: The repair requires delaying or serializing demon application bootstrap.

observation.summary: The first iteration-3 repair removed malformed CSS escapes, but immutable After still showed only TAP and the progress line: computed scorpionOpacity and wordmarkOpacity remained 0. The gate was functionally ready and handed off to the hunt title, so the remaining defect is specifically first-paint visual resilience under heavy concurrent boot.

conditions.scenario: cold open, 1200ms brand observation, then ready -> TAP -> hub

evidence.symbol: brand base styles and paScorpion/paBolts keyframes
evidence.statement: Scorpion, bolts and wordmark still use opacity:0 base styles, and scorpion/bolts keyframes explicitly begin at opacity:0.
Demon correctly prewarms under the gate; serializing load behind the intro would regress the previous touch-to-ready-title improvement.

hypothesis.cause: Brand identity is encoded as an animation-dependent reveal instead of a safe visible base state. Concurrent heavy boot can prevent the reveal from painting while the loader and TAP remain independently visible.
hypothesis.prediction: Make identity visible by default and animate transforms without opacity-zero entry. The brand will remain readable even when animation frames are starved, while load remains concurrent.
hypothesis.falsifier: Native source assertions fail, app boot becomes serialized, or immutable staging still reports zero logo/wordmark opacity.

candidates.reason: Keeps concurrent prewarm and the approved motion language while making the non-animated fallback visually complete.
Would recreate the serial wait that iteration 2 removed and make visual polish compete with hunt readiness.

implementation.summary: Make scorpion, bolts and wordmark visible in the base state, keep transform animation, and prevent animation keyframes from returning identity to opacity zero.

limitations: Hosted Chromium visual evidence is not a physical Pixel Fold benchmark.
The first corrective experiment remains immutable and will receive a refuted receipt; this record is the same-theme repair.
